messages:
Erin: Heads up — planning X carousel + LinkedIn longform pair for next week's product launch. Need assets, two copy variants, and inbound lead routing for webinar signups. Carousel = 3 slides (what/why/demo), LinkedIn = 300-400 word narrative linking to reg page. Thread here for asset pickup and scheduling. ETA: assets by Tue EOD.
Mike: I can design carousel. Can someone drop final hero image + 2 screenshots? Prefer 1920x1080 slides.
Sophia: I'll own the LinkedIn longform. Drafting two narratives: benchmark-focused and customer-story. Want benchmark numbers from analytics — @Sam can you share?
Sam: Sharing benchmark deck link: https://drive.reddoor/example-benchdeck (see slide 7-9). I'll pull the 99th pct latency and cost-per-token numbers.
Erin: Awesome. For X thread, here's a quick 3-tweet scaffold we can adapt:
```
Tweet 1: We just deployed a big perf upgrade — 2x throughput at 30% lower cost. Here's how.
Tweet 2: Key trick: dynamic KV caching + batch fusion — saved ~45% on tail latency.
Tweet 3: Join our webinar to see benchmarks + live demo -> [short link]
```
Mike: For scheduling, propose posting windows: LinkedIn Tues 10am PT, X Tues 11am PT, X thread shortly after. Anyone object?
Sophia: Works. Also recommend UTM params: utm_source=linkedin|x, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=launch_q2. I'll add to reg link.
Erin: Good. Need inbound routing: marketing wants leads into HubSpot with tag 'launch_q2' and immediate handoff to SDR queue for MQLs. Can ops set an automation so webinar registrants -> leads (tag) -> notify #sales-inbound?
Sam: I can set up HubSpot workflow. Question: do we route registrants only or all attendees? Recommend registrants -> nurture, attendees -> SDR hot leads.
Erin: Let's do registrants -> nurture; attendees -> SDR hot leads. Also set up an "urgent" flag if company size > 500 or org includes 'security' keyword.
Karen (marketing-bot): Reminder: assets deadline in 48h. Auto-checklist created: hero image, 2 screenshots, 3 caption variants, CTA shortlink.
Mike: Uploaded draft slides: https://drive.reddoor/example-carousel-draft.png — please review. Colors and type are placeholder.
Sophia: Draft A (benchmark narrative) posted: https://docs.reddoor/example-linkedin-A. Draft B (customer story) posted too. @Erin take a look and pick.
Erin: I like Draft A for top-of-funnel — stronger metrics. Sophia, please shorten to ~280 chars for the first paragraph so it's readable on X preview. Also add UTM to reg link here: https://go.redwood.com/reg?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_q2
Sam: HubSpot workflow created and test lead routed to #sales-inbound. One follow-up: set lead owner = 'SDR-rotation' and add 'launch_q2' property.
Erin: Perfect. Schedule mock posts in Buffer for Tue 10/11 PT and tag me for review. Thanks all :rocket:
Mike: will do. :thumbsup:
Sophia: done — scheduled in draft, pinging for final approval tomorrow.
